blocks.text: The Bangye-ri ginkgo tree, estimated to be around 1,319 years old, was still covered in bright yellow leaves as of Friday afternoon. But strong winds and freezing temperatures the following morning caused most of its leaves to fall between 7 a.m. and 8 a.m., according to Yonhap News Agency.
